title: FORGE — Synthetic Policy Book + Multi-Peril Scenario Set
description: FORGE is a scenario-coupled catastrophe-operations console for primary insurers and reinsurers. A single Monte-Carlo scenario set drives three optimization layers simultaneously — Portfolio MIP (CBC + PuLP), Operational LP (VRP for adjuster routing), and a claims pre-flagger — through a shared Decision Reconciler. This deposit bundles the synthetic 10,000-policy book, the multi-peril Monte-Carlo scenario set (hurricane, severe-convective-storm, wildfire, earthquake, winter storm), and the full codebase that generates and consumes them. The dataset card lives at docs/DATASET_CARD.md with full provenance, schema, and citation references. Every numeric value in the scenario calibration traces to a published source (HAZUS-MH 5.1, HURDAT2, NOAA Storm Events, TORRO + Brooks 2003, NIFC, Bakun-Wentworth 1997, NWS WSSI) — see research.md.
